name: Shatadal Samui
title: Software Engineer — Systems & Distributed Backends
tagline: Focused on low-latency systems, distributed services, and computer vision pipelines. Built with Rust, CUDA, TypeScript, Apache Kafka, and PostgreSQL.
about: I am a software engineer focused on systems programming, distributed backends, and hardware-accelerated computer vision. My primary toolchain spans Rust, CUDA, TypeScript, Apache Kafka, and PostgreSQL.

My recent work includes three key projects: SAMDEF, an edge computer vision system in Rust and CUDA for large-scale satellite imagery with native WGPU visualization; SAMEX, a cryptocurrency spot matching engine using an in-memory Rust order book and Kafka streaming real-time prices; and WALPAY, a full-stack digital wallet enforcing transactional consistency through PostgreSQL row-level locks and bank webhook idempotency.

I focus on building reliable, performant software by writing clean concurrent code, keeping resource usage predictable, preventing race conditions, and designing systems that run dependably without unnecessary external dependencies.
